jobs.subject: A large simple serif capital A being examined with one magnifying glass. The amber lens handle and pale-blue rim frame a small part of the letter, but the whole A remains recognizable. Only the letter A; no word, numeral or label.
jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE standalone decorative illustration for a CVeDI teaching slide card. Style: match a cohesive family of clean 2D educational editorial illustrations, bold rounded deep-blue outlines, broad flat opaque fills, simple familiar proportions, compact silhouette readable at 96 pixels, at most one slim offset rear edge. Palette: dark outline sky-950 #082F49, primary sky-800 #075985, pale sky #E0F2FE and #BAE6FD, white functional paper surfaces, one small vivid amber #F9C213 accent. Composition: a centered square motif filling 75 percent of the canvas with at least 10 percent transparent margin on all sides, essential clue near the center. Fully opaque object surfaces, genuine transparent alpha exterior. No gradients, modeled lighting, gloss, texture, shadows, glow, enclosing badge, decorative backdrop, logos, watermarks, extra ornament or tiny text. Exactly one isolated motif, not a sheet.
